alpha_rule: the host alpha is the smallest alpha of the ladder whose R3 passes; each rung is tried once, in order

changes.new: R2 gated on the FQE critic only, on concentration only: (a) mean E in T_wrong >= 3x the rich (R0, R1) mean; (b) the thin contexts' share of sum E^2 (pooled over all 5 contexts) >= 1.5 x their share of rows (base 0.30 -> 0.45; thin_share 0.50 -> 0.75); both in >= 80% of seeds (lean 4 of 5). Density-ladder marks unchanged but judged on FQE only. Accuracy is measured and reported, not gated: the level |e1| / |Q^pi| as before and the slope, the rich median |H_aa^-1 (grad_a Q1 - grad_a Q^pi)| / 2 at (s, pi(s)) with the exact per-context Q^pi of the evaluated policy. The HOST critic's R2 values are reported, not gated
changes.old: R2 gated on HOST (at the host alpha) and FQE: per seed and critic, mean E in T_wrong >= 3x the rich (R0, R1) mean, thin share of sum E^2 >= 0.60, rich median |Q1 - Q_td3| / |Q^pi| <= 0.05; all three in >= 80% of seeds for both critics; density-ladder marks on HOST and FQE

changes.new: the thin contexts' share of the host-vs-EXACT shortfall >= 1.5 x their mix share (base 0.45, thin_share 0.75); the other three R3 marks, the alpha ladder (2.5, 5, 10) and the 80%-of-seeds rule are unchanged
changes.old: the thin contexts hold >= 60% of the host-vs-EXACT shortfall

changes.new: matching round cap 10; R4 at S2 when OR-wrong and OR-thin are matched at S2 in >= 80% of seeds (lean 4 of 5), else at S1 under the same rule, else R4 fails; at the chosen level a seed whose family is unmatched counts as a non-positive seed (never dropped silently) and is excluded only from means and t-tests, and the payload records the excluded seeds; R4(4) and R7(b) anchors are evaluated at the same level; R7(d)'s matching-quality mark is unchanged
changes.old: matching round cap 5; R4 at S2 when OR-wrong and OR-thin are matched at S2 in every scored seed, else S1; a seed with an unmatched family fails every pooled mark

changes.new: fresh, never-run seeds (never through a training stage or an R2-R7 evaluation; the data-only r0r1 checks of seeds 5-9 listed in prior_outputs_on_fresh_seeds are the only earlier outputs): lean 5-9, full 5-14, density ladder 5-7; seeds 0-4 keep the original verdict

amendment.statement: POST HOC. This amendment re-registers the gate after the lean run on seeds 0-4 under pre-registration 255369889b400c2b... (outputs in runs/glq/255369889b400c2b/, record in outputs/glq/lean-v1/README.md) rejected the world (step 6 failed at alpha 2.5, 5 and 10 in the base world and the thin_share retune on the thin-shortfall mark; retune wrong_gain fails Stage 0). The new thresholds were chosen after seeing seeds 0-4: those seeds informed the amendment and keep their original verdict. Seeds 5-14 have never been through a training stage (critics, Tier A, Tier B, R5's regressors) or an R2-R7 evaluation; the only earlier outputs on any of them are data-only r0r1 checks of seeds 5-9 (listed in prior_outputs_on_fresh_seeds), whose marks this amendment does not change. They are fresh for every amended mark and are the confirmatory test. No BCA arm and no BCA band fit is approved.
amendment.unchanged: the world spec, Stage 0, the retunes (wrong_gain stays unusable: it fails Stage 0), the training settings, every other pass mark and the stop rule

bca.training_arm: off (glq_train.cotrain refuses mode BCA without allow_bca)

decoy.ns_reporting: mixture NS includes the decoy; rich marks use R0 and R1; per-context NS is always reported

B1.mark: max relative residual of V = r + gamma E V <= 1e-12 (K*, K2, behaviour, K = 0); another policy's (P, h) gives > 1e-3
B1.name: Bellman identity per context

B2.mark: |z| <= 3 per context: 100-step J of the behaviour clone and of the noisy behaviour
B2.name: Monte Carlo against the closed form

B3.mark: forward vs backward recursion <= 1e-10 relative; 4000 steps vs Lyapunov <= 1e-9
B3.name: Finite-horizon recursion

B4.mark: max |grad J_inf| at K* <= 1e-5 x at 0.5 K*, per context
B4.name: Riccati optimum gradient

B5.mark: bit for bit: harness_update hooks off (it 1 and 2), with a bc_multiplier, and Tier A's loop against td3_bc_update with the critic restored
B5.name: Harness steps equal td3_bc_update

B6.mark: OR-wrong, OR-thin, ANTI, EVEN, SHUF multisets, knob 0 = NONE, CAP in [1, 1.5), OR-D mean 1, OR-D = [-e_A]_+
B6.name: Oracle-weight identities

B7.mark: test_gapped_lq and test_glq_train: 0 failures and 0 errors
B7.name: Unit test suites

DECOY.mark: decoy median aleatoric target SD >= 3x the rich median
DECOY.name: Decoy noise

L1.mark: OR-wrong first-order gain - EVEN's at m = 2 > 0
L1.name: Level-1 screen (not a stop)

R0_pr.mark: >= 6.0 of 10 in every context, every seed
R0_pr.name: R0 participation ratio

R1a_rich.mark: all 4 action-covariance eigenvalues >= 0.05 in R0, R1, DECOY
R1a_rich.name: R1(a) rich actions explore

R1a_thin.mark: thin actuator-3-4 SD within 5% of the rung (rung 0: rank 2 and exact zeros), every rung
R1a_thin.name: R1(a) thin actions at the rung

R1b.mark: thin share of training rows = thin mix share +/- 0.03
R1b.name: R1(b) thin share

R1c.mark: >= 20% of the host's thin actions below 1% of the behaviour's peak density
R1c.name: R1(c) host leaves thin support

R2_ladder_falls.mark: FQE critic: thin mean E falls in >= 3 of the 4 rung steps (HOST: reported, not gated)
R2_ladder_falls.name: R2 dose-response

R2_ladder_top.mark: FQE critic: at rung 0.3, thin / rich mean E within [1/1.5, 1.5] (HOST: reported, not gated)
R2_ladder_top.name: R2 dose-response top rung

R2_ratio.mark: FQE critic: mean E in T_wrong >= 3x the rich (R0, R1) mean (HOST: reported, not gated)
R2_ratio.name: R2 error sits in T_wrong

R2_rel.mark: reported, not gated: rich median |Q1(s, pi(s)) - Q_td3(s, pi(s))| / |Q^pi|, Q_td3 = Q^pi + c_c the fixed point of TD3's smoothed target (a perfect critic reads 0; against Q^pi alone it reads 0.16-0.18; the former mark was <= 5%); the deterministic-reference value is reported too
R2_rel.name: R2 rich critic level accuracy

R2_slope.mark: reported, not gated: rich (R0, R1) median |H_aa^-1 (grad_a Q1 - grad_a Q^pi)| / 2 at (s, pi(s)), H_aa of the exact Q^pi of the policy the diagnostics evaluate: how far the critic's error shifts the recommended action
R2_slope.name: R2 rich critic slope accuracy

R2_thin_E2.mark: FQE critic: the thin contexts' share of sum E^2 (pooled over all 5 contexts) >= 1.5 x their share of rows (base world 0.45, thin_share 0.75) (HOST: reported, not gated)
R2_thin_E2.name: R2 thin share of E^2

R3_cost.mark: w_Tw x off-support cost in T_wrong >= 0.05 x the mixture gap
R3_cost.name: R3 off-support cost

R3_rich_ns.mark: host NS in the rich contexts (R0, R1) >= 0.30
R3_rich_ns.name: R3 critic useful where rich

R3_thin_shortfall.mark: the thin contexts' share of the host-vs-EXACT shortfall >= 1.5 x their mix share (base world 0.45, thin_share 0.75)
R3_thin_shortfall.name: R3 shortfall in thin contexts

R4_1.mark: mean NS(OR-wrong) - NS(EVEN) >= 0.05, p < 0.01, >= 80% of seeds positive (an unmatched seed is not positive)
R4_1.name: R4(1) OR-wrong beats EVEN

R4_3a.name: R4(3) best OR-thin vs best EVEN

R4_cap.mark: report NS(CAP-wrong) - NS(EVEN) at the R4 level (best - best when CAP-wrong cannot reach it); < 0.02 means the BCA test uses P1L placement
R4_cap.name: Capped oracle (report)

R4_level.mark: S2 (EVEN m = 2) when OR-wrong and OR-thin are both matched there in >= 80% of seeds, else S1 (m = 1.3) under the same rule, else R4 fails; at the level a seed with an unmatched family counts as non-positive and is excluded from means and t-tests (recorded)
R4_level.name: R4 strength level

R5_auroc_thin_decoy.mark: AUROC of the band, thin vs decoy rows >= 0.7
R5_auroc_thin_decoy.name: R5(ii) band is not noise

R5_auroc_wrong_rich.mark: AUROC of the band, T_wrong vs rich rows >= 0.7
R5_auroc_wrong_rich.name: R5(ii) band finds T_wrong

R5_confound.mark: |Spearman(E, aleatoric SD / |s| / distance)| <= 0.5, each context and pooled
R5_confound.name: R5(i) confounds

R5_ideal.mark: AUROC(high-error rows) of the |t - Q1| regressor >= the noise-only one + 0.10
R5_ideal.name: R5 ideal regressor beats noise

R5_tright.mark: mean E in T_right <= 0.5 x T_wrong
R5_tright.name: R5(i) T_right below T_wrong

R6b.mark: >= 20% of rich states beyond 2 logged-noise SDs
R6b.name: R6(b) rich shift

R6c.mark: ESS fraction in [0.05, 0.8] in at least one context
R6c.name: R6(c) Kish ESS

R6d.name: R6(d) BC start does not shift

R7a.mark: MDE <= 0.02 NS at 10 seeds (else the seeds needed, <= 20)
R7a.name: R7(a) minimum detectable effect

R7e.mark: not applicable: no Monte Carlo actor class in this gate
R7e.name: R7(e) Monte Carlo SE

S1.mark: (J(f K*) - J(0)) / (J(K*) - J(0)) <= 0.5 in every rich context
S1.name: Rich behaviour is mediocre

S2.mark: thin mix share x g >= 0.15 of the total gap
S2.name: Thin contexts hold room

S3.mark: K*_T_right in T_wrong: discounted-stable and loses >= 2 g against the behaviour
S3.name: Transfer is costly in T_wrong

S4.mark: >= 95% of logged and of optimal actions in [-1, 1]^4
S4.name: Action scale

S5.mark: the R0 marks on the exact behaviour state laws
S5.name: R0 in closed form

S6.mark: |K*_Tr,34 s| >= 0.3 on >= 30% of thin behaviour states
S6.name: Ideal transferred policy leaves the log

STAB.mark: sqrt(gamma) rho(A - B K) < 1 for all of them
STAB.name: Every policy used is stable

TB.mark: NS(OR-wrong) - NS(EVEN) > 0 and >= 0.5 x Tier A's mean, in >= 70% of seeds
TB.name: Tier B co-trained confirmation

retune_rule: at most two retunes, applied one at a time to the Stage-0 world in the listed order, only when step 5, 6 or 9 fails; a retuned world reruns the gate from Stage 0

retunes.name: thin_share
retunes.text: each thin context's episode share 0.15 -> 0.25 (mix R0 0.20, R1 0.20, T_wrong 0.25, T_right 0.25, DECOY 0.10)

seed_rule: a mark 'in >= f of 10 seeds' needs >= ceil(f n) of the path's n seeds
statement: Every pass mark, seed list, retune, alpha rung and setting of the Gapped LQ acceptance gate, fixed before any acceptance stage of this pre-registration trains anything. It carries Amendment A1 (see 'amendment'): post hoc, informed by seeds 0-4 of the original pre-registration, tested on fresh seeds 5-14. glq_acceptance.load_prereg refuses every stage when this file, its sidecar or a hashed code file differs.
